struck: The office is at 573 Vista Drive, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576, by appointment.
use: The office is on Vista Drive in Murrells Inlet, by appointment only.

pattern: \boffice\b[^.]{0,40}\bopen to the public\b|\bopen to the public\b[^.]{0,40}\boffice\b
struck: A Broker-in-Charge must keep an office open to the public.
use: A Broker-in-Charge must keep an office that the public, investigators and inspectors can reach during reasonable business hours.

struck: A buyer's agent in South Carolina must tell the buyer every material adverse fact the agent actually knows.
use: Once a buyer signs a written agency agreement, the buyer's agent must disclose all material adverse facts about the deal that the agent actually knows.

struck: Until then the buyer is a customer, and the firm acts as a transaction broker.
use: Until the buyer signs, the law presumes the buyer is a customer and the firm a transaction broker.

pattern: flood before the (?:seller|owner) (?:bought|owned)[^.]{0,40}(?:is not|isn't|never) asked|\bpast flooding only during\b
struck: A flood before the seller bought is not asked.
use: Four of the form's flood questions ask only about the seller's own years. No question asks directly about a flood before the seller bought, though one asks about any flood risk the seller knows of.

struck: If the home is in an association, the seller gives the buyer the state's association addendum before the contract is signed.
use: Unless the sale is exempt, the seller fills in the state's disclosure form before the contract is signed; for a home in an association, that includes a one-page HOA addendum.

struck: Of the homes for sale in Horry County that stand in FEMA's high-risk flood zone, only about 1 in 5 has a listing that marks a flood zone.
use: Of the homes for sale in Horry County whose map pin falls inside FEMA's high-risk flood zone, about 1 in 5 comes up when our home search is filtered for flood zone.
